input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — a law and forum outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and, as an exclusive foreign venue, walk-away territory. It also directly contradicts Section 28.2, which already gives the state and federal courts in New York County, New York exclusive jurisdiction, leaving the dispute forum ambiguous. The single replacement conforms 28.1 to New York governing law and deletes the conflicting Singapore forum, so the clause reaches the preferred position with 28.2 supplying exclusive New York County venue unchanged; the executive-escalation step in 28.3 and the carve-out for interim injunctive relief are acceptable and are preserved.

proposal.summary: Conform Section 28.1 to New York governing law and remove the conflicting exclusive Singapore forum.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We require New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, so we have replaced the Singapore governing law in 28.1 and deleted the Singapore forum, which conflicted with the New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
mappings.quote: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum.
